final: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scans s2 JOIN sites si2 ON si2.zoneregistry = s2.zoneref) AS share FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
